Preview1 forbids clone or copy, so all 512 MiB must pass through fd_read and fd_write, each at most 8 GB/s on one core (wasip1 is single-threaded). L = max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms, and ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64 > 0.236. Strictly, the two calls run sequentially (about 134 ms), so 67.1 ms is a conservative floor."}
